business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of PC and Console Video Games via Digital Stores

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (Aolepān Aorōkin Ṃajeḷ)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (national, unitary jurisdiction; corporate administration centralized in Majuro)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English-common-law-derived corporate jurisprudence blended with codified Marshall Islands Revised Code statutes and customary/traditional law; corporate law substantially modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Amended Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (2003), including trade and investment facilitation provisions
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), signed at Nuku'alofa on 14 June 2017 and in force regionally from 13 December 2020
Agreement Establishing the Pacific Islands Forum, as amended, providing a regional framework for trade and investment coordination
No standalone bilateral investment treaty or comprehensive double taxation agreement is currently in force for non-resident Marshall Islands business corporations

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI): (1) Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, Business Corporations Act, as amended, including beneficial-ownership record-keeping obligations for all RMI corporations; (2) Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2018 (Public Law 2018-26), as amended by the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (Amendment) Act 2021; (3) AML/CFT Regulations 2021; (4) Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) supervisory directives and Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation recommendations.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — UBO particulars are collected by the licensed RMI registered agent and maintained in a statutory UBO register; access is restricted to the RMI Registrar of Corporations, the Financial Intelligence Unit, AML/CFT supervisory authorities, and courts upon lawful demand. No public UBO filing or public register exists for RMI Business Corporations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each beneficial owner's and director's passport biographical page together with proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, issued within the last three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the country of origin is a Contracting State to the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961; otherwise Consular Legalization, or the receiving RMI registered agent's acceptance of a professionally certified copy in accordance with the AML/CFT Regulations 2021

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Independent bank reference letter confirming the financial standing and account relationship of each beneficial owner or of the parent funding entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated financial institution holding the account relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or secure locked correspondence accepted by the RMI reporting entity; an apostille is appended where the issuing jurisdiction is a Hague Contracting State and the receiving authority so requires

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference certificate for each proposed director, officer, and incorporator, attesting to identity, reputation, and business background
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed lawyer or certified accountant in the individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuer's jurisdiction is a Contracting State; otherwise Consular Legalization through the diplomatic mission of the receiving state or the RMI consular office

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarially executed draft Articles of Incorporation, Bylaws, and incorporator consents in preliminary form for filing with the RMI Registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: RMI-qualified attorney or licensed corporate service provider, with notarization in the execution country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as required for foreign-origin signatures; original notarized execution copies are retained by the RMI registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Name Reservation or Name Clearance Receipt issued by the RMI Registrar, and, following incorporation, the Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization for RMI-issued instruments where the receiving payment platform or bank requires certified public documents; apostille treatment may be accepted by the receiving jurisdiction despite RMI's non-party status only upon explicit receiving-authority waiver or validated legal opinion

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory Part 4 AML/CFT Act 2018 screening of all beneficial owners, directors, officers, and commercial counterparties (Valve Corporation Steam payouts and PlayStation Store / Sony Interactive Entertainment SEED payouts) against: (i) OFAC SDN, SSI, and sectoral sanctions lists; (ii) United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) RMI FIU domestic designations; and (iv) adverse-media and APG/Egmont Group intelligence. Onboarding requires negative screening evidence, PEP-status declaration, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth explanation, and retention of the completed risk file for at least five years after the termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Registrar of Corporations — Official Corporate Name Search and Reservation Database, maintained by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and accessible through the Registrar's online name-search facility
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the sole working language of the RMI company registry. Corporate names must be composed of Latin-script letters, may include numerals and punctuation such as ampersands, must end with a mandatory corporate designator such as Corporation, Incorporated, Company, or Limited, or a recognized abbreviation such as Corp., Inc., Co., or Ltd., and must be distinguishable from all reserved and registered names. Non-Latin-script corporate or brand names must be transliterated into romanized English at the time of filing; no native-script alternative is registered.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: The applicant may renew an active reservation by filing a written extension request with the Registrar and paying the applicable reservation re-filing tariff before the 30-day window expires; a maximum of two consecutive extensions is customarily granted. Rejection appeal: Within 30 days of an adverse name determination, the applicant shall submit a formal written appeal or administrative reconsideration request to the Registrar containing the proposed name, the statutory basis for distinguishability, and any required regulatory consent; if reconsideration is refused, the applicant may file an originating application in the High Court of the Marshall Islands under the Business Corporations Act seeking an order compelling registration of the name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a non-resident digital-publishing Business Corporation in the ISIC 5820 scope. The licensed RMI registered agent's physical Majuro address serves as the statutory registered office for service of process, while the company maintains no RMI operating premises because all PC and console publishing activities are conducted extraterritorially via Steam and PlayStation Store. A purely virtual, brick-and-mortar-free structure is compliant provided the RMI registered agent retains custody of the statutory corporate records and the UBO register.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low, estimated at less than 5% annual probability for a non-resident digital publisher with no local trading presence. The Registrar and the Financial Intelligence Unit predicate inspections on the registered agent's records rather than on the client's foreign operating sites; unannounced inspections are possible only against the registered agent's offices or statutory books and would target AML/CFT and UBO documentation rather than the tax-exempt non-resident's trading activities.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for RMI international corporate service providers

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate service provider and completing notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for RMI onboarding due diligence; statutory notarial tariff where applicable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, or destination jurisdiction's consular office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee for certified copy and certificate of status

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Secure international courier and electronic dossier delivery (APAC-US routing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International courier or corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for expedited document delivery

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, Title 53, Chapter 1, Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC), Sections 101 et seq., comprising the provisions on certificate of incorporation, registered office and agent, bylaws, board of directors, and organizational actions; read with the Income Tax Act 1989 (Title 54, MIRC) and the Business License Act (Title 25, MIRC) for non-resident tax-exempt and licensing treatment.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney-General, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro, RMI.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation (signed by the incorporator and filed with the Registrar of Corporations).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement; share capital may be nominal (commonly US$1.00 for 10,000 par-value shares) and zero-par or low-par shares are permitted under the BCA.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Bylaws presented to this meeting are adopted in full, and the Secretary shall place a copy in the corporate records. RESOLVED, that the subscription of the sole subscriber for 10,000 common shares, par value US$0.0001, for stated consideration of US$1.00, is accepted, and the President and Secretary are authorized to issue the corresponding share certificate upon receipt. RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be at the registered agent's address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the registered agent is appointed to act as such. RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed officers: [Name], President; [Name], Secretary; and [Name], Treasurer, to serve until successors are elected or appointed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands (through a licensed RMI registered agent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-availability inquiry to the Registrar or instruct the licensed registered agent to reserve the corporate name. The name must contain a corporate identifier (Corporation, Incorporated, Limited, Company or an authorized abbreviation) and must not be deceptively similar to an existing RMI entity. Upon clearance, execute the registered agent consent and record the agent appointment in the organizational minutes.
required_dossiers: Primary and two alternative name candidates
Engagement letter with licensed RMI registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, submit the alternative names for a fresh reservation within one working day; if the registered agent declines, appoint another licensed agent and re-file the consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Certificate of Incorporation and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations / corporate secretary and notary public.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Certificate of Incorporation (corporate name, broad purpose clause covering PC/console software publishing, authorized share structure, registered office and agent address, and incorporator particulars), together with the Bylaws and the initial written consent of the sole director. The incorporator signs the certificate; signatures may be delivered by electronic scan or facsimile. Transmit the completed package to the licensed registered agent for compliance verification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar notes non-compliant provisions, amend the certificate by a Certificate of Correction or re-execution and resubmit within the Registrar's correction window; legalize any defective acknowledgments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (filing counter or authorized agent portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Certificate of Incorporation with the Registrar, together with the registered agent's acceptance, and remit the US$250.00 statutory filing fee (plus any optional expedited fee). Upon acceptance, the Registrar stamps the certificate and assigns a corporate registration file number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for fee shortfall or defective signature, cure the deficiency within the notice period (typically 30 days), pay the balance or re-execute the signature block, and refile or convert to a correction filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Registrar's endorsed copy of the Certificate of Incorporation and the Certificate of Good Standing. Verify the exact legal name, registration file number, and date of incorporation, and activate the permanent corporate record file maintained by the registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the issued certificate contains clerical errors, submit a Certificate of Correction request to the Registrar for re-endorsement; any issuance delay is cured by a registrar acknowledgement letter confirming the effective date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Formalities, Tax Status Declaration, and Publisher Onboarding Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate secretary / sole director; RMI Revenue and Taxation Office, Ministry of Finance (non-resident tax-exempt status).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole director executes the first board written consent adopting the Bylaws, accepting the share subscription, fixing the registered office, and appointing the President, Secretary, and Treasurer. Issue the share certificate and maintain the share ledger. File the non-resident domestic corporation declaration with the RMI Revenue and Taxation Office confirming 100% non-resident ownership and absence of RMI-sourced business to secure income tax exemption. As a commercial preparatory measure, present the Certificate of Good Standing to Valve (Steamworks) and PlayStation Partner onboarding teams and to the corporate bank for account opening.
required_dossiers: Non-resident status declaration to RMI taxing authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RMI Revenue and Taxation Office questions the exemption, provide a statutory declaration and share register proving non-resident ownership and no RMI business activity; if an officer declines appointment, ratify a substitute appointment by supplemental board consent.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - RMI Ministry of Resources and Development (Industries Division) has no licensing remit over ISIC 5820 digital publishing; a local Business License under Title 25, MIRC is required only if RMI-situs physical or retail operations commence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - no factory, manufacturing, media-production, or broadcasting permit applies; distribution occurs solely through Steam and PlayStation digital storefronts and no statutory game rating or transmission license is triggered for an RMI-incorporated e-publisher.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA), established under the Environmental Protection Act 1984 (Title 25, MIRC).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA registration or full EIA report required; the corporation has no physical premises, industrial plant, construction activity, or discharge-generating operations in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, and its RMI presence is limited to the registered office and registered agent.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - zero discharge of wastewater, volatile organic compounds, or solid waste in RMI territory; if future office or server infrastructure is established, RMI EPA water-quality criteria and air-emission limits under Title 25, MIRC would apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable - no fire safety certificate, structural load inspection, or workplace occupancy clearance is required for a registered-agent address; the corporation employs no persons in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Banking and International Trade, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro; taxpayer services are conducted in person or through a licensed resident agent, with no publicly accessible electronic filing portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) is not mandatorily registered for Marshall Islands income tax or VAT. If a TIN is required for banking, contracting, or foreign tax purposes, the BC must submit an application through its appointed resident agent using the prescribed government form, together with the certificate of incorporation, registered agent acceptance, directors' and shareholders' particulars, and a declaration that no RMI-source business activity is conducted. The Revenue Commissioner issues a tax identification number; no VAT identifier exists because the RMI levies no value added tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A non-resident Marshall Islands BC may rely on its statutory exempt status by filing an annual confirmation of non-residence and non-conduct of local business with the Registrar of Corporations. There is no check-the-box or pass-through election because the RMI does not impose entity-level income tax on non-resident BCs. No hybrid mismatch elections are recognized under RMI law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No National VAT/GST; Local Gross Revenue Tax Only for RMI-Source Business Activity
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not Applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. A local business license is required only if the BC conducts commercial activity within the Marshall Islands; digital store publishing by a non-resident BC does not create such nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Marshall Islands imposes no real-time fiscal clearance, electronic invoicing mandate, API-based tax reporting, or digital stamping requirement for non-resident digital service providers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not Applicable - the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT, GST, or sales tax, and therefore has no export zero-rating mechanism. Digital publishing and distribution through Steam and PlayStation Store by a non-resident BC are outside the RMI indirect tax system; no zero-rating certificate or refund claim is required or available.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not Applicable - intangible digital supply via online stores involves no physical customs export
If physical media or hardware is ever shipped, standard RMI customs export declaration and commercial invoice would apply for cargo control, not for VAT purposes
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There are no VAT zero-rating clawback penalties because no VAT regime exists. However, false export declarations or attempts to claim fictitious exemption under RMI customs law may trigger fines, seizure/forfeiture of goods, and potentially criminal liability under the RMI Customs Act. A non-resident BC should retain Steam/PlayStation payout statements, platform contracts, and evidence of non-resident status to rebut any audit or tax-residency challenge.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not maintain a domestic central bank or a separate foreign-exchange administration. Prudential supervision and AML/CFT oversight of deposit-taking institutions are exercised by the Banking Commissioner, appointed under the Banking Act 1991 and operating within the RMI Ministry of Finance. Given that the U.S. Dollar is the sole legal tender pursuant to RMI constitutional law and the Compact of Free Association, the U.S. Federal Reserve (San Francisco) functions as the de facto monetary and payments authority, while local dollar clearing is intermediated through U.S. correspondent banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Fully convertible, unrestricted jurisdiction. The U.S. Dollar (USD) is the exclusive legal tender; RMI issues no national currency, so there exist no convertibility restrictions, no capital account controls, no exchange-rate spread, and no mandatory surrender regime. The RMI is an IMF Article VIII member, guaranteeing that payments and transfers for current international transactions are free from restrictions. Capital contributions, profit remittances, dividend distributions, and shareholder loan repayments from a non-resident Business Corporation are neither subject to RMI exchange approval nor to any repatriation tax or withholding tax. The only practical frictions are bank-level AML/KYC verification, OFAC/FATF screening via U.S. correspondent rails, and the requirement that the entity remain in Good Standing with the RMI Registrar. Because the Steam and PlayStation publishing revenue cycle is naturally USD-denominated, conversion needs are limited to optional outsourcing of development services in EUR, GBP, JPY, or KRW, which may be settled freely at negotiated bank rates.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI statutes impose no export-proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no settlement time limit. Digital game export proceeds received from Valve Corporation (Steam) and Sony Interactive Entertainment (PlayStation Store) may be retained indefinitely in USD or in any freely convertible currency. The only formalities are (i) designation of a licensed RMI commercial bank account or U.S. correspondent account, (ii) maintenance of a clean invoice/contract trail under the Steam Works and PlayStation Partner agreements, and (iii) submission of beneficial-ownership attestations for wires exceeding the bank's internal reporting threshold. No central-bank filing or exchange-control declaration is required.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Current Account; segregated Capital Escrow Sub-Account available for inbound equity injection and milestone-based development funding

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam (Majuro and Ebeye Branches)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account; non-resident commercial account with U.S. FDIC-insured parentage and direct Fedwire/FedACH clearing capability
Not applicable for non-resident BC treasury purposes; statutory development finance mandate only (domestic project lending, no commercial transaction account services)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability. The RMI has no e-money or EMI licensing regime, so no local EMI authorization exists, and offshore digital EMI providers (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Revolut Business) generally reject or restrict RMI-registered entities because of jurisdictional risk policy and the absence of an EMI passporting arrangement. A non-resident BC should therefore maintain its statutory USD transaction account with an RMI-licensed commercial bank (BOMI or Bank of Guam) or a U.S. correspondent bank. If an offshore EMI is used solely as a segregated pay-in collection vehicle for Steam/PlayStation balances, the EMI must (i) expressly permit RMI corporate clients, (ii) be limited to B2B platform settlements rather than consumer deposit-taking, and (iii) be swept daily to the licensed RMI/USD account. The entity's commercial risk tier is 'Low_Risk_Standard' under the pipeline classification, which supports this two-tier structure, but the EMI route remains legally fragile and operationally secondary.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Hybrid remote/physical mandate. Neither the RMI Banking Act nor bank policy imposes an absolute statutory requirement that directors appear physically in Majuro or Ebeye. Both commercial banks permit remote onboarding of foreign-owned non-resident BCs provided that (i) a senior compliance officer conducts a live video-interview KYC (Zoom/Teams, Pacific business hours), and (ii) all corporate opening documents are certified or attested by the RMI licensed registered agent. In practice, Bank of Guam's Majuro branch may require in-person or video identity verification for at least one director and the designated authorized signatory, while BOMI will accept a notarized identity packet (passport, proof of address, corporate resolutions) supplemented by a video interview. A voluntary physical visit to the Majuro or Ebeye branch materially reduces onboarding time to approximately 10-15 business days; remote-only onboarding typically requires 20-30 business days. U.S. West Coast directors may use Bank of Guam's Guam headquarters for in-person identity verification in lieu of RMI travel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt status under the RMI Business Corporations Act flagged as a potential shell/offshore conduit lacking economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registrar-issued Certificate of Exemption from Income Tax; current Certificate of Good Standing; confidential beneficial-ownership attestation prepared by the licensed registered agent under the RMI Business Corporations Act (as amended for international FATF alignment); and a substantive activity narrative demonstrating a live game publishing operation (executed Steam Works Distribution Agreement, PlayStation Partner License, game development roadmap, outsourced development contracts) notwithstanding the absence of physical employees in RMI.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital video-game payout flows perceived as vulnerable to laundering through in-game asset markets, skin trading, or consumer microtransaction aggregation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Contractual proof that all inbound value originates exclusively from Valve Corporation (Seattle) and Sony Interactive Entertainment (San Mateo/Tokyo) as B2B publisher settlement channels, with no consumer-facing deposit handling; an entity-level AML/KYC policy addressing treasury separation from any in-game marketplace; an independent compliance audit confirming the absence of peer-to-peer item trading flows; and a correspondent-bank reference letter from the parent entity's Tier-1 bank confirming the publisher's commercial model is low-risk standard.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owners or passport holders originating from high-risk or sanctions-listed jurisdictions, or use of nominee shareholders in the ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized passport copies for all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners; 12-month bank reference from a Tier-1 international bank evidencing lawful account conduct; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statement supported by audited financial statements and residence-country tax filings; a formal RMI legal opinion confirming the absence of nominees and the validity of the ownership chain; and independent World-Check/Refinitiv sanctions screening results for all individuals. If any passport is from a high-risk jurisdiction, a declaration of lawful funds and an enhanced due diligence report by the bank's designated compliance consultant is appended.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Steam publishing counterparty reputation risk driven by industry association with chargebacks, refund fraud, or vendor-payment disputes triggering underwriting caution
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed Steam Distribution Agreement and PlayStation Partner License evidencing settlement-only counterparty relationships with large-cap exchange platforms; a treasury policy confirming no consumer chargeback exposure and no aggregation of third-party funds; audited financial statements demonstrating stable, invoice-backed USD cash flows; and a written undertaking to transact exclusively in USD through the licensed RMI account with all outbound disbursements supported by invoices or milestone certificates.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant route: inbound equity or shareholder-loan capital is injected by SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire for U.S.-based remitters) in USD to the non-resident BC's account at BOMI or Bank of Guam. Because RMI imposes no capital controls, no central-bank approval, no filing, and no conversion requirement is triggered. Protocol: (i) the BC board of directors adopts a capital injection resolution recorded with the registered agent; (ii) the remitting parent/shareholder issues wire instructions using the bank's internal purpose code for 'equity injection' or 'intercompany loan' (SWIFT transaction type field 50F/56A fully populated for OFAC screening); (iii) for injections above USD 100,000, the bank's compliance team receives a copy of the transfer instruction, a source-of-funds statement, and the remitter's bank statement evidencing lawful derivation; (iv) the BC records the funds as paid-in capital or shareholder loan in its corporate books; and (v) if a Capital Escrow Account is used, funds are held in a segregated sub-account subject to milestone release conditions defined in the board resolution.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Digital publishing outbound flows comprise (i) royalty and license payments to developer studios (SWIFT MT103, USD or cross-currency), (ii) platform fees to Valve/Sony, which in practice are net-settled by the store before payout to the entity, (iii) vendor payments for marketing and localization services (Commercial LC under UCP600 or SWIFT MT103), and (iv) dividend and shareholder loan repayments (SWIFT MT103 with appropriate payment details). Clearing rails: U.S. correspondent banks provide Fedwire/CHIPS clearing for USD-denominated flows; SWIFT MT103 is used for cross-border payments involving EUR, GBP, JPY, KRW, and other currencies; Commercial Letters of Credit are reserved for milestone-based co-publishing agreements and any physical-goods procurement (e.g., localized console packaging or promotional merchandise). The absence of a domestic RTGS system means all clearing is intermediated via the U.S. clearing system through BOMI and Bank of Guam correspondent relationships. Steam payouts to the entity are received via ACH or wire into the U.S. or RMI USD account; PlayStation Store regional statements may require separate EU/JP collection accounts, with balances swept via SWIFT to the RMI concentration account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Outright FX Forwards (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, JPY/USD, tenor up to 12 months) transacted through a Tier-1 offshore investment-grade counterparty
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) for currency exposures with limited onshore convertibility, including KRW/USD for Korean developer and localization service payments

Cross-Currency Swaps (fixed-to-fixed EUR/USD and USD/JPY) for long-dated net investment hedging or balance-sheet mitigation where multi-year platform settlement contracts are denominated in non-USD currencies
Vanilla FX Options (zero-premium collars or purchased protective USD puts) to cap adverse USD appreciation against EUR/JPY revenue flows without margin-intensive structures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Annual Franchise Tax (Business Corporations Act 1990, Section 108)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands; filing is submitted through the company's licensed Marshall Islands registered agent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the anniversary date of incorporation; no uniform calendar-year due date. The registered agent normally prepares and files the report in the 30- to 60-day window preceding the anniversary, and the filing becomes delinquent if not completed by the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A flat US$200 delinquency penalty applies if the annual report and franchise tax are not settled by the anniversary date. If the delinquency continues for 60 days or more after the anniversary, the Registrar of Corporations may administratively dissolve or strike off the corporation. Reinstatement requires payment of all outstanding annual franchise taxes, the US$200 late penalty, and the applicable reinstatement fee.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit applies to a non-resident, tax-exempt Marshall Islands business corporation. An independent audit is triggered only when the board of directors orders an audit, shareholders validly requisition one under the Business Corporations Act, or a foreign tax authority, investor, or listing requirement imposes it on the group.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Business Corporations Act prescribes no mandatory accounting framework for non-resident corporations; books and records of account must fairly reflect transactions and financial position. Non-resident entities commonly adopt IFRS or U.S. GAAP voluntarily for management, commercial, and foreign-group reporting purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands does not require a separate annual public UBO return for non-resident business corporations. The licensed registered agent must collect, verify, and maintain current beneficial ownership information confidentially at the registered office. Any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be reported promptly to the registered agent, evidenced by a stock transfer form and any required board or shareholder resolution, and recorded in the Register of Members and the confidential beneficial ownership records. The annual franchise-tax filing confirms only the company name, registered office, registered agent, and current directors and officers; it does not serve as an annual UBO re-declaration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (minutes of shareholders' and directors' meetings)
Registered Agent and Registered Office record
Confidential Beneficial Ownership records maintained by the registered agent

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$850 - US$2,500 per annum; typical mid-market fee for a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent and registered office service is US$1,200 - US$1,800 per annum, with many providers bundling the US$100 government fee into the total.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required for a non-resident tax-exempt entity; if voluntarily commissioned for investor, financing, or foreign-group reporting purposes, a proportionate audit typically ranges from US$4,000 to US$12,000 per engagement depending on transaction volume and complexity.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None required; the Marshall Islands levies no corporate income, branch, capital gains, or payroll tax on non-resident Business Corporations (MH_BC). No statutory tax holiday or preferential deduction regime exists because the jurisdiction is zero-rated. The tax-loss carryforward concept is statutorily inapplicable; the schema integer is retained for technical conformity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in the Marshall Islands. The mandatory equivalent is the Business Corporation Annual Renewal and Economic Substance Notification, filed with the Registrar of Corporations through the licensed registered agent portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due annually on the corporation's anniversary filing date (generally the last calendar day of the corporation's fiscal year as elected under BCA Section 36) and payable, with the annual license fee, before the anniversary of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered legal name of the MH_BC entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the English name exactly as shown on the certificate of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent name and registered address in Majuro.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A mainland Marshall Islands agent is mandatory; the non-resident owner may not substitute a foreign address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full list of incumbent directors and officers, with any changes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents are permitted; disclosure of beneficial ownership is required at registrar level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of authorized and issued shares, par value, and consideration for issue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare classes of shares held by non-resident shareholders; minimum capital is not required but disclosure must match the incorporation instrument.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Notification of relevant ESR activity (e.g., IP holding, distribution/service center, headquarter function).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A pure Steam publishing/marketing intermediary must truthfully declare whether core income-generating activity occurs in the Marshall Islands or abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the annual license fee by authorized capital tier plus any late penalties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees are calculated on issued shares and paid by the registered agent; e-payment confirmation must be retained for the Steam and PlayStation store compliance files.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual renewal and license fee: USD 75 additional if paid within 30 days after the annual filing date; USD 300 (or Registrar-coordinated escalating penalty) if later; continued default results in administrative dissolution/revocation of the certificate of good standing, automatic loss of capacity to enforce publishing and payout agreements, and reincorporation risk.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no substantive income tax treaty network and imposes no domestic dividend withholding tax; therefore no DTA relief protocol, TRC submission, or administrative refund claim is required to repatriate dividends to non-resident shareholders. Where the inbound payer jurisdiction applies withholding (e.g., a U.S. payer on Steam/PlayStation settlements), the steam account holder may request a Marshall Islands tax residency certificate from the Registrar/Competent Authority to evidence non-U.S. resident status; withholding relief is determined solely by the payer jurisdiction's domestic rules because the MH_BC is a tax-exempt entity.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on royalties and cross-border interest is 0%. Payments from the MH_BC to foreign licensors/creditors for IP rights or debt financing are distributed gross with no domestic withholding and no treaty rate to reduce.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Marshall Islands transfer-pricing statute fixes any Local File or Master File submission threshold; the zero-tax regime produces no transfer-pricing liability. Nevertheless, the ESR Annual Notification and substantiation obligations apply irrespective of revenue thresholds to any relevant entity, including non-resident business corporations holding IP or performing distribution/service functions for digital video-game publishing; the operator must maintain contemporaneous substance and accounting evidence (local board minutes, bank records, and expenditure) in the Marshall Islands.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (as amended) require every relevant entity carrying on relevant activity - expressly capturing IP ownership, distribution and service centers, and headquarters - to file an economic substance notification and an annual substantiation report with the Registrar. Although the MH_BC remains tax-exempt, core income-generating activities must be managed and directed in the Marshall Islands, with adequate premises, full-time employees, and operating expenditure proportionate to gaming publishing revenue; mobile game/digital-settlement functions cannot be designated to a post-box.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying the ESR declaration, filing false annual license returns, or misrepresenting a non-resident tax-exempt entity to avoid value-added, sales, or corporate tax in the market jurisdiction while collecting United States or European digital gaming revenue through Steam and PlayStation settlements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Business Corporations Act and the ESR Act: fine up to USD 10,000 per false filing, administrative dissolution, forfeiture of the certificate of good standing, and court-ordered disgorgement of misdeclared profits for the relevant years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly sign false declarations are personally liable for restitution; criminal conviction carries imprisonment up to 5 years, with asset freeze and travel ban issued by the Attorney-General pending trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Structure and ESR Deficiencies
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a pure post-mail entity with no local decision-making, no Marshall Islands bank account, no local employees, and no ESR annual report while deriving replication-related publishing income as an IP company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR enforcement: monetary penalty for the entity of up to USD 10,000 plus a daily surcharge for continued non-compliance; potential strike-off and adverse listing with the Registrar that blocks the company from executing digital-store agreements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors continuing trade after strike-off become personally liable for the company's debts; the court may pierce the veil, allow creditor claims against personal estates, and impose imprisonment up to 1 year for operating an unauthorized entity; travel restrictions can be applied in cross-border insolvency assistance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Deficiencies
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving and re-routing Steam/PlayStation payouts without customer due diligence, beneficial-ownership verification of business accounts, suspicious transaction reporting, or a designated compliance officer, thereby facilitating laundering of proceeds derived from fraud, card-testing, or ransomware payments hidden in micro-transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands AML/CFT Regulations and Banks Act: administrative fines up to USD 50,000 per violation, revocation of any money-services license, freezing of transaction accounts, and disgorgement of unlawful proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Responsible officers face civil forfeiture of assets, personal financial penalties, travel bans under mutual legal assistance requests, and imprisonment up to 10 years for money-laundering predicates; the corporate veil is pierced for knowing participation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Mischaracterized Cross-Border Distribution and Unauthorized Money Transmission
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structurally labeling Steam and PlayStation net revenue as 'royalties' or 'cost reimbursements' to shift margin to the zero-rate jurisdiction while the actual controlled business is distribution/service-center activity performed outside the Marshall Islands, or settling player refunds and marketplace balances through the MH_BC without any payment-services license in the payer's market.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Business Licensing Regulations: fine up to USD 5,000, license revocation, and refusal of Registrar authentication; tax authorities in the payer jurisdiction may re-characterize the arrangement and impose gross-basis or branch-profit taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve deceptive invoicing are jointly and severally liable for claw-back claims and stuck interest at the statutory judgment rate; foreign judgments are enforceable against their personal assets, and nationals/non-resident directors can be stopped at the border upon issuance of a criminal complaint.
